Summarise Small Classes by School

Source: R/school_summary.R
summarise_small_classes.Rd

Summarises small classes within each school, where small classes contain at most `threshold` students.

School identification uses `est_id` preferentially, falling back to `est_wonde_name` if `est_id` is unavailable.

Class identification uses `class_name` preferentially, falling back to `c_wonde_name` if `class_name` is unavailable.

Column names are resolved using the package's configurable column-name system.

Usage

summarise_small_classes(class_list, unique_id_col = NULL, threshold = 3)

Arguments

class_list

A class-list data frame using configured or internal column names.

unique_id_col

Optional student identifier column. Can be an internal key (e.g. `"ome_id"`), configured name (e.g. `"OME_ID"`), or another column present in the data. If NULL, each row is counted as one student.

threshold

Numeric. Maximum class size considered small. Defaults to 3.

Value

A tibble containing the selected school identifier, using its configured column name, followed by:

TotalClasses

Number of classes in the school.

SmallClasses

Number of small classes.

StudentsInSmallClasses

Total students in small classes.

SmallClassSizes

Comma-separated small class sizes.

TotalStudents

Sum of student counts across classes.

PercentInSmallClasses

Percentage of student counts belonging to small classes.

Details

Column selection is based on availability, not missing values. If `est_id` exists, it is used even if some values are NA. The same applies to `class_name`.

When a unique identifier is supplied, distinct non-missing identifiers are counted within each class. Otherwise, each row is treated as one student.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
summarise_small_classes(class_list_df)

summarise_small_classes(
  class_list_df,
  unique_id_col = "ome_id",
  threshold = 5
)
} # }
